$comment: Kind Notes Birthday Magazine — edition model. Everything is a 4-page block because saddle-stitch binding requires the total page count to be divisible by 4. Skipping a single page would produce an unbindable 19- or 21-page book, so pages are only ever added or removed four at a time.

binding.note: This is why skip and add-on both operate on blocks, never single pages.

base_edition.composition: 16 core pages + 1 optional lifestyle block (4 pages)

addon.note: price_eur_per_unit is a placeholder — set against real print cost per signature.
